title: macOS desktop returns permission_missing although Python was allowed
symptom: desktop doctor or click returns permission_missing (accessibility or screen_recording) on macOS
cause: macOS grants Accessibility and Screen Recording to the app that started the command (Terminal, iTerm, VS Code, Orca), not to python3
fix: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility: turn on the terminal app that runs the agent
System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording: turn on the same app
Quit and reopen that terminal app, then launch_cli.py desktop doctor
